en: A black-and-white vintage photograph of a parade with children and a few adults dressed in various international costumes, carrying banners and flags, some of which display names of countries or regions such as 'Hindustan,' and recognizable emblems including crosses, the crescent and star, and the Union Jack. The street is lined with people watching, and the architecture features European-style buildings with ornate balconies.
